name: Ethena EthenaMinting (USDe live minter)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bounded bypass

narrative.summary: USDe’s only mint authority is administered by a real 24-hour timelock whose sole proposer and canceller is a 5-of-10 Gnosis Safe. Every call that would redirect funds or create unbacked USDe sits behind that delay; a few freeze and configuration calls do not.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20 as target index 14 (Sepolia block 11740952, tx 0x14b0466a…7a98), so Ethereum L1 now tracks 15 targets and this card reads the live minter directly. Same convention as the USDtb PSM: adminKey 65, multisig 100, timelock 55 (oracle 100, crossExposure 20, composite 73 as pushed; the 20 is the same-root-Safe overlap with four other tracked Ethena targets, the USDtb PSM and the three LayerZero OFTAdapters, 100 minus 20 for each). USDe.minter(), the minter’s owner and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and USDe’s own owner all resolve to one EthenaTimelockController (getMinDelay 86,400s); USDe.setMinter, the strongest control, and the six admin selectors that would redirect funds or mint unbacked USDe (grantRole, transferAdmin, addCustodianAddress, addSupportedAsset, setTokenType, setStablesDeltaLimit) are confirmed not whitelisted, so the full delay applies. Instant lanes: the Safe alone can revokeRole and add or remove whitelisted benefactors, which freeze or configure but cannot mint; four other whitelist entries (disableMintRedeem and three role removals) are dead because the timelock does not hold GATEKEEPER_ROLE. Disclosed, not scored: the Safe also holds COLLATERAL_MANAGER_ROLE directly, so it can sweep the minter’s roughly $93M (USDC, USDT and USDtb, about $31M each) to one of five registered custodian EOAs with no delay (adding a custodian is delayed), and four bare-EOA gatekeepers can halt minting and strip roles instantly, though the Safe can revoke them instantly too. The Safe also has an EthenaSafeGuard installed since 2026-07-06 (a positive control, not scored). A compromised MINTER key alone cannot create unbacked USDe: an order needs a whitelisted benefactor’s EIP-712 signature and real collateral routed to a registered custodian. Seven collateral assets are active (USDC, USDT, DAI, USDtb, PYUSD, USDm, USDG), all valued 1:1 by decimals and never priced, so issuer or depeg risk of those tokens, notably the thin USDm, is the remaining route to a bad mint that needs no delayed admin action. Open points: role-holder completeness rests on an indexer’s logs because free RPCs cannot replay history, the timelock’s source is only a partial verification match (behaviour confirmed by simulation), and the custodians’ real controllers are not attributable on-chain.
